title: Inner Light · morning promo · 01-bedroom-dawn
prompt: Cinematic vertical 9:16 film, 35mm look, soft natural grain, natural light only. Muted palette with periwinkle and slate-blue tones, warm haze, never clinical white. One person alone, unhurried, eyes closed or turned from the lens, never smiling at camera. Camera barely moves: a slow push-in or a held frame, no whip pans. Any phone in shot is an ordinary smartphone with a dim, unreadable screen. No text, no logos, no subtitles. A dim bedroom before sunrise, blue light at the edge of the curtains, a woman in her thirties asleep on her side. A smartphone lies face-up on the nightstand and its screen lights the wall softly. Nothing else moves. Held frame, very slow push-in.
